issues.reason: Asserting (Member sk_no_go_1 no_go) and (From sk_no_go_1 schwarzenegger) at (STV 1.0 0.99) puts a Schwarzenegger no-go into the KB as fact when the sentence only hypothesizes one — false content, which the calibration line makes a defect however uncovered the construction is.

The clear_the_track bundle plus (Future sk_clear_1) at full strength asserts that the track will be cleared for Riordan, whereas the text states only that it would be cleared if the no-go came — asserting more than the text states.

Possessive / genitive NP makes `Possession` the opaque catch-all for 'ownership, kinship, and looser association alike' with the possessed first, and 'Los Angeles mayor Richard Riordan' does state a Riordan-Los Angeles link (he held its mayoralty), so the atom is true and licensed; the office has no separate symbol here.

gaps_confirmed: a hypothetical 'would V' whose antecedent is a nominal rather than an if-clause — Counterfactual is subjunctive-only (had V-ed / would have V-ed) and the indicative-conditional Implication route is stated only for if-clauses, so nothing says how a nominal antecedent maps onto a rule premise
'former N' as a prenominal cessation marker — the cessation bundle is stated only for the 'no longer / not anymore / used to' wordings
'another N' — the alterity presupposition (that Schwarzenegger is also a Republican) has no carrier
new_gaps: 'former' over a MULTI-ATOM predicate ('former Los Angeles mayor') — Negation (copular) requires a negated multi-atom predicate to be denied as one strength-0 (And …), but the cessation pattern emits per-atom denials, so the association half gets denied on its own
repair_summary: Replaced the flatly asserted no-go atoms and the flatly asserted clear_the_track event bundle with a single indicative-conditional (Implication …) rule — premise (And (Member $x no_go) (From $x schwarzenegger)), consequent the Skolem-event clearing with its Future and Beneficiary atoms at (STV 1.0 0.9) — so neither the hypothesized no-go nor the predicted clearing is asserted to occur; every other atom, including the Riordan typing/name atoms and the 'former' Past + strength-0 pairs, is untouched.
notes: The Implication is the instruction set's own carrier for an indicative conditional, so this is not an invented encoding; no strength-0 antecedent bundle is added because 'would clear' is an open hypothetical, not a Counterfactual whose antecedent is presupposed false.
